name: Yun (Beijing Mandarin; ElevenLabs library) on eleven_v3
_: Read by kit/audio/el.mjs when it is run through this folder's symlink with node --preserve-symlinks-main, so the kit's own code (the only reader of the ElevenLabs key) records the reader's retakes on eleven_v3, SCRIPT.md's fallback model. The kit is not changed. The voice is named, and el.mjs reads its id from kit/audio/voices.local.json.
